title: Kissed Tangy Portuguese Caramel Mousse
description: A tangy and glassy-jelly Portuguese dessert featuring caramel, with a brine-dry and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly twist
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over the water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and sea salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally
Bring the cream mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes
Remove the cream mixture from the heat and stir in the caramel sauce, lemon juice, and softened gelatin
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
Just before serving, whip the mixture with an electric mixer until it becomes light and airy
Spoon the mousse into individual serving cups and drizzle with port wine, if using
Serve the mousse chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sea salt
